truth.why: 61% → 78% in one day, ~300 GB of hv-simulator nightly images pulled yesterday afternoon. At that rate the 80% alert is hours away and the disk is full in ~2 days; not exhausting in minutes, but Ken needs to prune or the pulls stop. handoff with the rate. escalate_now is early; handle misses the trajectory.
truth.effort_why: flipped handle→handoff between draws; a rate to compute
